about: Scenes found on YouTube for each text, checked through YouTube's own embedded player (plays embedded, length) and its captions (the second each key line is spoken). themes are short names: power = abuse of power, men / women = the role of men / women. Found 2026-11-16.
how: Playlists listed through the embedded player (PL-KykV_4XmWNyOd5Nkvzfc8O4NPuSTUEu goes through the film in order; also PL2Of7J5L2SMIr0-mJhoyh_0KHOu5ASQkr, PL6H_6YWwXlwlmximnSlI1cyjvCiRzHXL1), then each video checked. Movieclips' own clips refuse to play embedded (error 150). Two clips of sexual assault (7jKCa54blg8, mBlJ9N7Ehgk) were left out.
